mapper.sql: vehicle_id, cargo_id, fork_height, cargo_height, roll_deg, pitch_deg, load_offset_x, load_offset_y, risk_level, risk_code, message, source, detected_at, received_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_load_safety () VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{cargoId}, #{forkHeight}, #{cargoHeight}, #{roll}, #{pitch}, #{loadOffsetX}, #{loadOffsetY}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskCode}, #{message}, #{source}, #{detectedAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cargo_id = VALUES(cargo_id), fork_height = VALUES(fork_height), cargo_height = VALUES(cargo_height), roll_deg = VALUES(roll_deg), pitch_deg = VALUES(pitch_deg), load_offset_x = VALUES(load_offset_x), load_offset_y = VALUES(load_offset_y), risk_level = VALUES(risk_level), risk_code = VALUES(risk_code), message = VALUES(message), source = VALUES(source), detected_at = VALUES(detected_at), received_at = VALUES(received_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT ls.vehicle_id, ls.cargo_id, ls.fork_height, ls.cargo_height, ls.roll_deg, ls.pitch_deg, ls.load_offset_x, ls.load_offset_y, ls.risk_level, ls.risk_code, ls.message, ls.source, ls.detected_at, ls.received_at, ls.updated_at FROM vehicle_load_safety ls JOIN vehicle v ON v.vehicle_id = ls.vehicle_id WHERE v.active = true ORDER BY ls.vehicle_id
